source_refs.note: 2. Nutrient Overload (Eutrophication): a main subheading of 33.5 Effect of Water Pollution on the Environment, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 255-255.

blocks.text: Fertilizers aur sewage se aane wali excess (faltu) nitrogen aur phosphorus se nutrient overload hota hai aur algae tezi se barhti hai. Algae dhoop rok leti hai aur pani mein oxygen kam kar deti hai. Eutrophication ecosystems bigarti, machhliyan aur doosri marine species (samandari jaandaar) maarti aur pani ki quality kharab karti hai.
